title: Meshtastic compatibility audit and ux-default bead process
description: Process task from spec 19 §11, §12. Audit Meshtastic T-Echo and Heltec UX for: screen order, battery icon shapes, button feel. Where Meshtastic convention exists and doesn't conflict with spec 19, match it. Where they conflict, this spec wins — record each divergence in a ux-default bead. Establish the tiebreaker process: fewer states → less power → Meshtastic → fail toward less info. Any future UX decision not covered by spec 19 gets decided by tiebreaker, recorded in a ux-default bead, and the agent proceeds without human input (except SOS §8). Spans spec 19 requirements 65-69, 75.
